# @cache-kit/cache

> 标签: JavaScript

## 简介

Framework-agnostic cache orchestration core: tag/dependency invalidation, multi-level composition, stampede protection, and the provider SPI that backend packages (@cache-kit/cache-memory, @cache-kit/cache-redis, ...) implement.

## 官网

- npm 页面：https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cache-kit/cache
